metricHelp.crossDomainRank: Rank of the same model in the other domain among all 165 candidates by cosine similarity. Rank 1 is best; the domain-centered view uses centered signatures.
metricHelp.signatureCosine: Cosine similarity between this model's Agent500 and Math100 signatures. Higher values indicate stronger cross-domain stability.
metricHelp.percentile: Rank converted to a 0-100 percentile among 165 candidates. Higher is better; 100% corresponds to rank 1.
metricHelp.responses: Number of responses in the selected domain averaged to form this model-level signature.
